description: Coca-Cola's India operations run primarily through Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages Pvt Ltd (HCCB), a separately MCA-registered bottling entity. Figures below are HCCB's India financials; stock price is the global parent KO (NYSE).

marketing_spend.derivation: A specific HCCB FY25 advertising-expense line was not located in aggregator snippets. Modeled at ~5-10% of HCCB's FY25 India revenue (₹12,751 crore), in line with typical FMCG beverage ad-to-sales ratios, giving ~₹638-1,275 crore. business_updates.headline: HCCB FY25 profit falls 73% to ₹756.64 crore as revenue dips 9% to ₹12,751.29 crore, largely due to a high FY24 base from bottling-divestment gains
